name: jengo/schema
description: Custom declarative ORM and Database Schema mapping tool for CodeIgniter 4. Enables data hydration, fluent query building, relationship mapping, cursor-based and offset pagination, TypeScript definitions generation, and computed properties using PHP Attributes.

attributes.description: Maps the annotated Schema class to an underlying CodeIgniter 4 Model and Entity.

arguments.entity: class-string (Optional Entity class for custom hydration)

attributes.description: Marks the target property as the primary key of the database schema.
Maps a property to a database field, enabling searchable filters and value casting.

arguments.searchable: bool (If true, this field is scanned during search operations, defaults to false)
arguments.cast: Jengo\Schema\Hydration\Enums\Cast (Casts database values to array, bool, int, float, string, object, datetime, json)

attributes.description: Annotates a getter method to declare a computed field dynamically generated based on dependent fields.

arguments.name: string (The name of the computed attribute in JSON output)
arguments.dependants: array of strings (Fields that must be selected/fetched for the computation to run)
arguments.cast: Jengo\Schema\Hydration\Enums\Cast (Optional cast for the computed result)

attributes.usage:
#[Computed(name: 'full_name', dependants: ['first_name', 'last_name'])]
public function getFullName(): string { return $this->first_name . ' ' . $this->last_name; }

attributes.description: Declares a derived field that fetches data dynamically outside standard table columns.

arguments.foreignKey: string (The local foreign key column mapping)
arguments.ownerKey: string (The target table's primary key mapping)

arguments.foreignKey: string (The target table's foreign key mapping)

query_builder.description: Fluent query wrapper constructed via the query() helper. Manages criteria composition, join resolution, sorting, cursor-based pagination (using base64-encoded cursors via after option), and offset pagination. In OPEN mode, pagination is controlled directly via request parameters.

methods.where: where(string $column, mixed $value, bool $isOr = false): self (Applies basic filter)
methods.limit: limit(int $limit): self (Applies query limit and enables pagination)
methods.after: after(string $cursor): self (Applies opaque base64-encoded cursor for infinite scrolling)

commands.name: jengo:schema setup
commands.description: Publishes the default config/JengoSchema.php file into the project app/Config directory.

commands.name: jengo:schema generate
commands.description: Dynamically scans active PSR-4 model directories to automatically map, draft, and generate PHP Schema classes and optional TypeScript definitions.

options.--table: Generate schema for a specific table only
options.--ts-dir: Specify custom output directory for TypeScript interfaces

helpers.name: query
helpers.description: Agnostic entry point to start a schema query chain.

helpers.name: dump_query
helpers.description: Dumps all queries executed by the QueryLogger for debugging purposes.
